name: Normal-mapped sprite lighting
oneLiner: Sprites catch the light: every sprite drawn through the module writes its normals (from an L-05 normal map, or derived from the drawn shape) into a buffer, and one I-08 WebGL pass relights only those pixels from a key light, point lights and short flashes (and J-01's lights when present), with glints on curved edges and a rim light on silhouettes. Energy-neutral: a face turned to the viewer keeps its colour, faces toward the sun or a lamp brighten and warm, faces turned away darken and cool, so a sprite keeps its mean brightness and saturation; a 'daylight' preset gives visible form with no lamps at all. Without WebGL, or without a normal map, the sprite draws exactly as before.
fits: top-down adventure and action RPG (characters, trees, rocks, crates, lamps)
side-scrolling platformer / action (hero, enemies, coins, blocks)
painted HD sprites with L-05 normal maps, and canvas-drawn vector sprites (normals derived from the shape)
night, dusk and dungeon scenes with J-01 lights (it reads their light list)
any 2D canvas game, HD or pixel, on the I-08 post pipeline
notFor: games already drawn with WebGL or a 3D engine (use the engine's own normal-mapped lighting)
lighting the ground, sky or backgrounds (that is J-01; this element lights sprites only)
sprites rotated at arbitrary angles (mirrors and 180-degree turns are handled; other rotations keep the unrotated normals)
tiny 1-bit pixel sprites under ~12 px (there is no room for relief)

needs: I-08 webgl-post (GameDNA_Post) loaded first; the game's existing instance, or one the module creates
render() once per drawn frame on every draw path
the game's step-counted clock in ms (flicker, flashes; deterministic ?t=&freeze=1)
the sprites' draw calls: drawSprite(img, map, ...) for bitmaps, shape(key, box, fn) around canvas-drawn sprites
optional: L-05 normal maps (nh2) or any normal map image; without one, 'derive' or plain drawing
optional: a camera offset for lights in world units; point lights, flashes on hits; J-01 lights on the same post
provides: one relighting pass on the I-08 chain (order 250, the scene-light band, after J-01), skipped on frames with no sprite
normal and albedo buffers (I-08 inputs nlNormal, nlAlbedo) the size of the game canvas
key light, up to 8 point lights (own + J-01), flashes, specular glints and rim light
normals derived at runtime from bitmaps ('derive') and from canvas-drawn shapes (shape / begin-end), cached per key
stats() and drawnBoxes(): sprites, shapes, derive cost, lights used, errors

variants.name: Daylight (default: no lamps, warm sun from up-left, cool shadows)

assets: module/normal-lighting.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_NormalLight): drawSprite / shape / begin-end, normal + albedo buffers, runtime normal derivation (alpha distance field + luminance, Sobel), L-05 nh2 / gl / dx map conversion with mirror handling, own lights and flashes, J-01 light reading, one I-08 pass
requires elements/webgl-post/module/webgl-post.js (I-08), shipped next to it in the combo
the demo uses the L-05 sample pack (elements/normal-maps/assets) and two L-00 images (oak, ground, path patch); the module ships no images

module.skin: none: the module draws nothing of its own on the game canvas (it relights the sprites the game draws)
